```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(kableExtra)
library(plotly)
library(stringr)

# Init Step to make sure that the dependencies are loaded
htmltools::tagList(ggplotly(ggplot()))
set.seed(42)

```

```{r, echo=F}

plot.heatmap <- function(metric.data) {
  # ========== settings 
  pt2lw <- function(pt) pt * (96 / 72.27) / .pt
  font_family <- "sans"
  min_folds        <- 10     # only plot genes selected in at least this many folds
  high_folds       <- 20    # threshold separating the "consistent" group
  folds_per_repeat <- 5
  col_selected     <- "#406FB6"
  col_not_selected <- "#9FB7DF"
  
# =======================
  
  fold.genes <- lapply(metric.data$features, 
                           function(x) unique(x[!is.na(x)]))
  genes <- sort(unique(unlist(fold.genes)), method="radix")
  sel <- vapply(fold.genes, function(g) genes %in% g,
                logical(length(genes)))
  rownames(sel) <- genes 
  
  n.folds.total <- ncol(sel)
  n.selected    <- rowSums(sel)
  
  ord        <- order(-n.selected, rownames(sel), method = "radix")
  sel        <- sel[ord, , drop = FALSE]
  n.selected <- n.selected[ord]
  
  sel_plot <- sel[n.selected >= min_folds, , drop = FALSE]
  n_genes  <- nrow(sel_plot)
  n_high   <- sum(n.selected >= high_folds)  # genes selected in >= high_folds folds
  n_mid    <- n_genes - n_high               # genes selected in min_folds..(high_folds - 1)
  n_repeat <- n.folds.total / folds_per_repeat
   
  # message(sprintf("%d genes plotted: %d selected in >= %d folds, %d in %d-%d folds",
  #                 n_genes, n_high, high_folds, n_mid, min_folds, high_folds - 1))
   
  # ---- Long format for ggplot --------------------------------------------------
  plot_df <- data.frame(
    rank   = rep(seq_len(n_genes),        times = n.folds.total),
    fold   = rep(seq_len(n.folds.total),  each  = n_genes),
    status = factor(as.vector(sel_plot),
                    levels = c(TRUE, FALSE),
                    labels = c("Selected", "Not selected"))
  )
   
  # ---- Bracket helper (drawn to the right of the heatmap) ----------------------
  x_br <- n.folds.total + 3     # x position of the bracket (in fold units)
  tick <- 1.8                   # length of the bracket end ticks
   
  bracket <- function(y0, y1, label) {
    list(
      annotate("path",
               x = c(x_br - tick, x_br, x_br, x_br - tick),
               y = c(y0, y0, y1, y1),
               linewidth = pt2lw(0.6), colour = "black", lineend = "butt"),
      annotate("text", x = x_br + 2, y = (y0 + y1) / 2, label = label,
               hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 7 / .pt, lineheight = 0.95,
               family = font_family, colour = "black")
    )
  }
   
  # ---- Plot --------------------------------------------------------------------
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = fold, y = rank, fill = status)) +
    geom_raster() +
    # white lines between repeats
    geom_vline(xintercept = seq(folds_per_repeat, n.folds.total - folds_per_repeat,
                                by = folds_per_repeat) + 0.5,
               colour = "white", linewidth = pt2lw(0.8)) +
    # dotted white line separating the >= high_folds group from the rest
    geom_hline(yintercept = n_high + 0.5, colour = "white",
               linewidth = pt2lw(0.9), linetype = "11") +
    # brackets labelling the two groups
    bracket(0.6, n_high + 0.1,
            sprintf("Selected in\n\u2265%d%% of folds\n(n = %d)",
                    round(100 * high_folds / n.folds.total), n_high)) +
    bracket(n_high + 0.9, n_genes + 0.4,
            sprintf("Selected in\n%d\u2013%d%% of folds\n(n = %d)",
                    round(100 * min_folds / n.folds.total),
                    round(100 * (high_folds - 1) / n.folds.total), n_mid)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Selected"     = col_selected,
                                 "Not selected" = col_not_selected)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(folds_per_repeat / 2 + 0.5, by = folds_per_repeat,
                                    length.out = n_repeat),
                       labels = seq_len(n_repeat), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_reverse(breaks = c(1, 50, 100, 150, 200), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    labs(title = sprintf("Gene selection frequency (%d CV folds)", n.folds.total),
         x     = sprintf("Cross-validation repeat (%d folds each)", folds_per_repeat),
         y     = "Genes ranked by selection frequency") +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(title = NULL)) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 8, base_family = font_family) +
    theme(
      plot.title        = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 6)),
      axis.title        = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black"),
      axis.text         = element_text(size = 7, colour = "black"),
      axis.line         = element_line(linewidth = pt2lw(0.6), colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks        = element_line(linewidth = pt2lw(0.6), colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"),
      legend.position   = "bottom",
      legend.text       = element_text(size = 7.5),
      legend.key.size   = unit(3.2, "mm"),
      legend.margin     = margin(t = 2),
      plot.margin       = margin(t = 6, r = 80, b = 6, l = 6, unit = "pt")  # room for brackets
    )
   
  print(p)
}

obtain.table.prop <- function(metric.data, unnested.features) {
  fold.genes <- lapply(metric.data$features, 
                           function(x) unique(x[!is.na(x)]))
  genes <- sort(unique(unlist(fold.genes)), method="radix")
  sel <- vapply(fold.genes, function(g) genes %in% g,
                logical(length(genes)))
  rownames(sel) <- genes 
  n.selected    <- rowSums(sel)
  n.selected <- n.selected[names(n.selected) %in% unnested.features]
  # Check which features haven't been selected, and just set them to 0.
  unselected.features <- setdiff(unnested.features, names(n.selected))
  unselected.counts <- rep(0, length(unselected.features))
  names(unselected.counts) <- unselected.features
  n.selected <- c(n.selected, unselected.counts)
  n.selected <- round(n.selected[unnested.features]/30, 3)
  print(n.selected %>% as.data.frame%>% kbl(align="c") %>% kable_styling(full_width = F, position="left", bootstrap_options="bordered"))
  n.selected
}

```

```{r, echo=F}

load.metrics <- function(comparison="gbm.v.met", path.to.root="../../..", unnested.features=NULL) {
  metric.table <- data.frame()
  # Load folders
  folder.names <- list.dirs(file.path(path.to.root, "results", "nested",
                                      paste0(comparison, ".RNA")),
                            recursive=F)
  feature.sel.prop <- matrix(data=NA, nrow=length(unnested.features), ncol=0)
  rownames(feature.sel.prop) <- unnested.features
  for (folders in folder.names) {
    # For each folder, load in the files
    file.names <- list.files(folders, recursive=F, full.names = T)
    for (files in file.names) {
      # Then parse the parameters
      fc <- str_extract(files, "(?<=fc-).*(?=_model)")
      model <- str_extract(files, "(?<=_model-).*(?=_feature-sel)")
      fsm <- str_extract(files, "(?<=feature-sel-).*(?=_boots)")
      boots <- str_extract(files, "(?<=boots-).*(?=_sel-prop)")
      sel.prop <- str_extract(files, "(?<=sel-prop-).*(?=_top-k)")
      top.k <- str_extract(files, "(?<=top-k-).*(?=_comparison)")
      print(model)
      cat(paste0("\n\n## FSM=", fsm, " Model=", model, " \n\n"))
      
      # Load in the data file.
      metric.data <- readRDS(files)
      med.auc <- round(mean(metric.data$auc), 3)
      med.sens <- round(mean(metric.data$sens), 3)
      med.spec <- round(mean(metric.data$spec), 3)
      med.acc <- round(mean(metric.data$acc), 3)
      
      # Scan through each fold and record the proportion that each feature
      # was selected
      prop.list <- table(unlist(lapply(metric.data$features, unique)))/length(metric.data$features)
      # Obtain the full list of genes, and check which ones
      # appear per fold.
      plot.heatmap(metric.data)
      
      n.selected.method.specific <- obtain.table.prop(metric.data, unnested.features)
      feature.sel.prop <- cbind(feature.sel.prop, n.selected.method.specific)
      
      curr.table <- data.frame("Accuracy"=med.acc,
                               "Sensitivity"=med.sens,
                               "Specificity"=med.spec,
                               "AUC"=med.auc,
                               "FSM"=fsm,
                               "Model"=model)
      
      metric.table <- rbind(metric.table, 
                            curr.table)
      print(curr.table %>% kbl(align="c") %>% kable_styling(full_width = F, position="left", bootstrap_options="bordered"))
    }
  }
  cat("\n\n# Summary \n\n")
  # For the metric table, generate the mean of each metric, and also create the bootstrap
  # intervals
  mean.row <- c()
  for (i in 1:4) {
    metric.column <- metric.table[,i]
    mean.metric <- round(mean(metric.column), 3)
    B <- 10000
    boot.means <- c()
    for (b in 1:B) {
      boot.metric.column <- sample(metric.column, size=length(metric.column), replace=T)
      boot.means <- c(boot.means, mean(boot.metric.column))
    }
    mean.lower <- round(quantile(boot.means, 0.025), 3)
    mean.upper <- round(quantile(boot.means, 0.975), 3)
    
    mean.row <- c(mean.row, paste0(mean.metric, " (", mean.lower, "-", mean.upper, ")"))
  }
  mean.row <- c(mean.row, "Mean", "Mean")
  metric.table <- rbind(metric.table, mean.row)
  print(metric.table %>% kbl(align="c") %>% kable_styling(full_width = F, position="left", bootstrap_options="bordered"))
  
  cat("\n\nMean selection prop \n\n")
  print(feature.sel.prop %>% rowMeans %>% round(3) %>% as.data.frame %>% kbl(align="c") %>% kable_styling(full_width = F, position="left", bootstrap_options="bordered"))
  
}
```
